cases.stdout:
{"schema_version":1,"command":"help","ok":true,"exit_code":0,"usage":"Usage: tired [creation options] COMMAND [ARG...]
       tired create [options] -- COMMAND [ARG...]
       tired plan [--offline] [options] -- COMMAND [ARG...]
       tired  (interactive dashboard; compact list without a terminal)
       tired profiles list | show ID | validate FILE [--json]
       tired profiles install FILE | remove ID [--user] --yes
       tired profiles explain [options] -- COMMAND [ARG...]
       tired config show | validate FILE [--user] [--json]
       tired recover [--user] [--json]
         [--transaction UUID --resolution finish|rollback --yes]
       tired doctor [NAME] [--user] [--json]
       tired status NAME [--user] [--json] [--check-active]
       tired list [--user] [--json]
         [--active-state STATE] [--enabled-state STATE] [--profile ID] [--search TEXT]
       tired show NAME [--user] [--json | --unit] [--effective] [--output NEW_FILE]
       tired logs NAME [--user] [--json] [--follow] [--lines 0..10000]
         [--since @SECONDS|UTC_TIMESTAMP] [--boot current|BOOT_ID]
       tired start|stop|restart|enable|disable NAME [--user] [--json]
         enable/disable: --now also changes current runtime state
       tired edit NAME [options] [--refresh-profile] [--restore-managed]
         [--apply-mode restart|defer] [-- COMMAND ARG...]
       tired rename NAME NEW_NAME [--yes] [--user] [--json]
       tired remove NAME [--yes] [--keep-history] [--user] [--json]
       tired --help | --version | --build-info [--json]

Common: --system|--user, --json, --no-tui, --yes, --quiet, --verbose,
  --color auto|always|never, --allow-risk CODE (repeatable).
Creation/edit: --name NAME, --description TEXT, --run-as USER, --group GROUP,
  --working-directory PATH, --type TYPE, --restart POLICY, --restart-sec TIME,
  --hardening baseline selects an explicit preset with compatibility warnings.
  --start|--no-start, --enable|--no-enable, --network none|network|online,
  --start-limit-interval TIME, --start-limit-burst INTEGER,
  --retry-policy persistent|limited, --nofile SOFT:HARD, --set FIELD=VALUE, --unset FIELD,
  --env KEY=VALUE, --pass-env KEY, --env-file PATH, --import-env-file PATH,
  --credential NAME=PATH, --unit, --json, --output NEW_FILE.
  --sensitive-arg INDEX masks a workload argument (1 is the first after COMMAND).
  --enable-linger explicitly proposes an account change with --user; full review required.
Sensitive exports: --include-sensitive --allow-risk sensitive-export --output NEW_FILE.
Arguments after COMMAND or -- belong to the workload. Planning never executes it.
"}
